task: The caller is about to act on a pending decision and wants to know whether it can be undone before deciding.
rationale: one-way-door classifies a pending decision as reversible or irreversible; 'decision' and 'reversible' are its own description words. premortem's description says it is Not for a live decision's reversibility, and that exclusion sentence names exactly this query's vocabulary, so a lexical router that scored every description token would rank premortem first for the query its own description routes away (observed 2026-09-03 before ao skills find learned to penalise exclusion-only tokens). This golden is the reciprocal of rq-02: premortem must win its plan-challenge query and lose this one.
notes: Added 2026-09-03 with the exclusion-aware scoring in cli/internal/skills/find.go; the pair this golden pins is premortem vs one-way-door in the direction rq-02 does not cover.
